name: Custom Tabs
overview: Adds support for custom tabs to be added to the Jellyfin webpage. Commonly used to add Requests tab.
description: Adds support for custom tabs to be added to the Jellyfin webpage. Commonly used to add Requests tab.

versions.changelog:
Added support for 12.3 and 12.4
Fixed issue with tabs appearing to logged out (guest) users (PR #73, @S2ciOnur)

name: Collection Sections
overview: Adds home screen section for collections/playlists
description: Adds home screen section for collections/playlists

versions.changelog: Added support for all 12.x versions, I'm too slow to migrate to HSS natively and this is quicker. Apologies for the delay in getting this released. There is still plan to move this to HSS, but for now have a release!

name: File Transformation
overview: Adds support for plugins to change jellyfin-web content without actually modifying the files directly but intercepts the requests for the served data.
description: Adds support for plugins to change jellyfin-web content without actually modifying the files directly but intercepts the requests for the served data.

versions.changelog:
Added support for JF Versions 12.3 and 12.4

No other changes are contained in this release.

name: Media Bar
overview: Adds a media bar element at the top of the homepage on Jellyfin web
description: Adds a media bar element at the top of the homepage on Jellyfin web

versions.changelog:
Added support for 12.3 and 12.4
Merged in latest from MakD upstream repo

name: Plugin Pages
overview: Adds support for plugins to define their own user settings pages, rather than just admin sided.
description: Adds support for plugins to define their own user settings pages, rather than just admin sided.

name: Home Screen Sections
overview: Adds support for server provided home screen sections
description: Adds support for server provided home screen sections
